name: NYC Benefits Platform: Benefits and Programs Dataset
description:
This dataset catalogs New York City benefits, programs, services, and resources, with one row per program or service (97 rows in this sample). Each record includes a unique ID, program name and acronym, page type (Program, Service, Benefit, or Resource), category (such as cash and expenses, housing, health, work, or family services), the administering government agency, and the population and age groups served. It also provides plain-language descriptions, eligibility summaries, and "heads up" notes, along with detailed application instructions covering online, mail, in-person, and phone options, including application URLs, downloadable PDF forms, office location links, and call-to-action labels. Additional fields describe required documents, help and support channels (online, in-person, email, 311, and other phone lines), and a last-updated timestamp. Text fields contain HTML markup and are in English.

The dataset supports building benefits screeners and eligibility navigators, program directories, and multilingual or plain-language
